title: CLTR Cutover PublicationAttempt record
description: Phase 136P, Implementation Group 5. Shape-only wire contract for a PublicationAttempt companion record (CLTR-CUTOVER-EXECUTABLE-SCHEMAS-001 v1.0 Sec.25). A PublicationAttempt document describes an attempted publication operation bound to a specific candidate, certification, and CAS expectation; it never itself performs publication, invokes compare-and-swap, mutates an authority pointer, establishes current authority, proves a publication occurred, proves a CAS succeeded, activates CLTR authority, demotes or retires legacy authority, triggers notification, or creates production markers or receipts (Sec.1, Sec.40). Legacy lifecycle remains the sole production authority; CLTR remains derivative. Tier 1 (strict): additionalProperties: false, no _extensions escape hatch (Sec.14). authority_role 'authoritative' is locally forbidden (Sec.9's 12-file list includes publication_attempt). This is the third and final embedding site for cas_expectation (Sec.4 row 10, Sec.24), deferred from Phase 136N per shared/references.schema.json's own disclosure. attempt_id is deterministic (digest of request_reference + candidate_reference + attempt_sequence), never timestamp-derived alone (Sec.25) -- this is precisely how a replay (identical bound fields, identical attempt_sequence, identical attempt_id) is distinguished structurally from a retry (new attempt_sequence, new attempt_id); created_at is documentation only, never an identity mechanism.

schema_id.description: Always present. Identifies this document as validated against the PublicationAttempt schema.

schema_version.description: Always present. This file's own MAJOR.MINOR version.

contract_version.description: Always present. CLTR-CUTOVER-EXECUTABLE-SCHEMAS-001 version this schema was generated against.

record_type.description: Always present. Fixed family tag for this record type.

record_id.description: Always present. Shape-checked only; never recomputed at Layer 2.

record_digest.description: Always present. Digest of this document itself. Shape-checked only; never recomputed at Layer 2.

created_at.description: Always present. Documentation only -- never the identity mechanism for this record (attempt_id is).

migration_epoch.description: Always present. Every companion record binds to exactly one migration epoch (Sec.7.2, CSCH-INV-1).

transition_id.description: Always present. publication_attempt is one of the families requiring transition_id (Sec.7.2).

attempt_id.description: Always present (Sec.25). Deterministic: digest of the bound-field tuple (request_reference, candidate_reference, attempt_sequence), never timestamp-derived alone. Distinct from record_id (the generic envelope identifier) -- this schema shape-checks attempt_id only; actual determinism (that it truly is the digest of those bound fields) is a Layer 4 responsibility.

request_reference.description: Always present. Family-tagged reference, with schema_id/schema_version required per Sec.12's cross-family-reference rule, to the CutoverRequest this attempt scopes to. A valid reference never implies the referenced request exists or matches (Layer 4).

candidate_reference.description: Always present. Family-tagged reference, with schema_id/schema_version required, to the CutoverCandidate this attempt publishes. A valid reference never implies the referenced candidate exists, matches, or is eligible (Layer 4).

certification_reference.description: Always present. Family-tagged reference, with schema_id/schema_version required, to the Certification backing this attempt. A valid reference never implies the referenced certification exists, matches, or is current (Layer 4).

cas_expectation.description: Always present (Sec.25). Every expected-state field within this embedded component is itself unconditionally required (Sec.24). This record's embedding is the third and deferred-since-136N site (shared/references.schema.json's own disclosure). Presence of a schema-valid cas_expectation never itself proves a CAS was attempted or would succeed (Sec.40).

source_authority_reference.description: Always present. Family-tagged reference to the source (legacy) AuthorityEpoch. A valid reference never implies the referenced epoch exists or is currently active (Layer 4/6).

target_authority_reference.description: Always present. Family-tagged reference to the proposed target AuthorityEpoch. Sec.25 does not forbid source_authority_reference and target_authority_reference from referencing an identical epoch record; no such restriction is invented here (mirrors certification.schema.json's Sec.23 precedent).

attempt_sequence.description: Always present. Monotonic per request_reference (Sec.25) -- monotonicity itself, across multiple documents, is a Layer 4 responsibility; this schema only requires a non-negative integer shape.

temporary_pointer_reference.description: Conditionally present: Sec.25 states this field is 'present only during in-flight publication' but Sec.16's local conditional-validation table does not name an enum value that structurally triggers its requirement or forbiddance -- disclosed as NON-BLOCKING-136P-1 (same category as 136N's disclosed field-gap fills, e.g. NON-BLOCKING-136N-4/5). This schema leaves the field freely optional (present-if-applicable) rather than inventing an unfrozen if/then condition; enforcing the actual in-flight-only constraint is deferred to a future semantic validator (Layer 4) once Sec.16 is amended or a later phase clarifies the trigger.

state.description: Always present. Shared PublicationState (Sec.8.5, 12 values). 'publication_uncertain' requires uncertainty; 'gate_rejected' or 'conflict' requires failure_classification (both enforced below). A schema-valid state here never itself proves publication, CAS success, or gate outcome truth (Layer 4/5/6).

uncertainty.description: Conditionally present: required when state is 'publication_uncertain', forbidden otherwise (Sec.25).

failure_classification.description: Conditionally present: required when state is one of 'gate_rejected', 'conflict', forbidden otherwise (Sec.25).

authority_disclosure.description: Always present. authority_role 'authoritative' is locally forbidden on this record (Sec.9's 12-file list); is_authoritative remains const false per the shared definition regardless. A valid PublicationAttempt record never itself proves a publication occurred, a CAS succeeded, or that authority changed -- it is a structural attempt record only.

request_reference.description: A record_reference locally restricted to record_family 'cutover_request', with schema_id/schema_version unconditionally required (Sec.12 cross-family rule).

candidate_reference.description: A record_reference locally restricted to record_family 'cutover_candidate', with schema_id/schema_version unconditionally required.

certification_reference.description: A record_reference locally restricted to record_family 'certification', with schema_id/schema_version unconditionally required. Preventing a candidate, authorization, or any other family from being substituted for the certification binding.

epoch_reference.description: A record_reference locally restricted to record_family 'authority_epoch', used for both source_authority_reference and target_authority_reference (mirrors certification.schema.json's epoch_reference precedent -- no schema_id/schema_version required).

reason.description: Always present when this object is present. Short, fixed-purpose uncertainty disclosure sentence.

uncertainty.description: Bounded local uncertainty-disclosure object (mirrors authority_state.schema.json's uncertainty $def). Present only when state is 'publication_uncertain'.
